f64_normal_note: Float64 normals use the 1024-layer ziggurat of SPEC.md Appendix A in every port, and every row with f64_normal true is measured with it. A new Float64 normal row must carry ziggurat true.

ports.note: The mt19937 figures move with code layout: in a program with only that loop, std::mt19937_64 with std::uniform_real_distribution<double> reaches 8.2 GiB/s.

ports.name: CUDA
ports.note: Each row first runs its own fill for two seconds, then times 21 fills, and the table gives the median. In the last run the fastest lay at most 6 % above the median on every row.

ports.name: SYCL
ports.note: Each row first runs its own fill for two seconds, then times 21 fills, and the table gives the median. After the two seconds every fill runs at the card's 250 W power cap, so the rows give the capped rate.
